findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "prompt-guard" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_prompt_injection · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_prompt_injection · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
